The water addition was therefore not assigned family-wide. For Devices A–D it is specimen-supported and recorded on each device; for the other arms it remains group-level context (20 μL, 2% volume ratio; span-9411a19929e4).

The reported water/reference PCE comparisons (MA 17.6% to 18.7%, FAMA 18.7% to 20.3%, and GA 0.31% to 0.38%), the higher-Jsc comparisons, and the Cs output comparison concern group-labeled devices without supported individual-device identities. They were not converted into IndividualDevices or PerformanceObservations (span-3cd672020dae).

The maximum-power-point passage reports stable Jsc with PCE close to the J-V values for corresponding devices, but it does not identify the physical devices or provide specimen-specific values. No individual stabilized-power observation was created (span-f65f5416b200; span-36ade2544d06).

The light-intensity-dependent results, including MA slopes from 1.62 to 1.2 KT/q and FAMA slopes from 1.54 to 1.21 KT/q, are reported for processing groups rather than supported individual devices. They were not represented as individual PerformanceObservations (span-3c3465ac3681; span-99382d871292; span-91cdbe768354).

The statement concerning 40 independent devices covers statistical results for MA, FAMA and Cs devices, but the supplied text does not unambiguously establish a separate sample size of 40 for each material or treatment group. One cross-family population record preserves the reported sample size without assigning unsupported per-family sample sizes (span-542f7c20dabe; span-e3a69a340380).

The stability evidence identifies material-family comparisons with and without water but does not identify individual physical cells, checkpoint times, or numerical retained-performance values. The tests are therefore linked only to their explicit device families, not to Devices A–D (span-731e090acdfb; span-e3a69a340380).

The source reports a J-V scanning protocol of 1.2 to -0.05 V but does not explicitly label the scan direction as reverse. The protocol is preserved verbatim and scan_direction is left not_reported rather than inferred (span-1607e9674f66).

The ordered FTO/SnO2/perovskite/Spiro-OMeTAD/Au stack and electron- and hole-transport functions are explicit, but the source does not explicitly use the polarity label n-i-p. Polarity is therefore left not_reported while the source-reported planar architecture is retained (span-d8457859399c; span-454800fbbf0a; span-b794a60d7945).

The FAMA first-annealing temperature varies among Devices A–D and is therefore retained on the individual devices rather than asserted as one family-wide condition. The common first-annealing duration and common second-annealing conditions remain in the family process (span-b794a60d7945).

Films A1–D1, films A–D when discussed only for XRD, XPS, SEM, AFM, absorption or related characterization, FTO/perovskite TRPL partial stacks, and MA/FAMA films stored for two weeks are characterization specimens rather than additional photovoltaic device families or stability tests (span-294f18779ca8; span-6fd6d53153b4; span-91cdbe768354; span-f8fde1c12e6a).
